runtime_override.restore_condition: New explicit Roger approval after quality stabilization; automatic restoration is forbidden
runtime_override.restore_review_threshold_proposal: Three consecutive episodes pass R-49/R-52/R-53 and the complete corrected gate chain, Roger viewing finds no systemic regression, and no BLOCKER defect repeats
runtime_override.inflight_nonactive_policy: Harvest and persist already-paid in-flight results, then HOLD_WORKFLOW_DEBUG without starting the next stage

slot_refill_rule: A slot may be refilled only after its current episode completes the entire release loop and has a verified platform publication receipt, or after an explicit authorized removal. Local final, package ready, QA PASS, source lock, edit completion, generation completion, or any other pre-publication milestone does not release a slot. After the release receipt is verified, immediately start the first eligible episode from next_episode_queue.
line_activity_rule: Every allocated episode line must continuously carry active_work plus a real evidence handle: a local PID/process, an unfinished remote task_id, or a same-round completed delivery with the next item already started and recorded. A dependency blocker must include blocked_by and blocker_ref, while a non-conflicting local task for that same episode is selected whenever possible. Old artifacts, planned next fields, and supervisor status files are not activity evidence.

conditional_machine_admission_policy.rule: After reasonable targeted repair is exhausted, a reversible creative-quality FAIL must not stop the production line when at least one technically usable candidate preserves screenplay facts, identity, location/time, core action and downstream compatibility. Select the best candidate, admit it conditionally and continue.

release_rule: Concurrent production does not change episode/timeline/coverage manifest order for final source lock, edit admission, package, platform upload, replacement, or deletion.
